answer: Each agent renders the challenge text to one SVG image on an 800 by 600 canvas within 10 minutes and publishes its hash. The verifier re-renders the same text with the same canvas and compares its SVG hash, so a copied grove cannot pass as fresh work. One honest agent runs 1 render job on 2 cores for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 jobs on 20 cores, so compute cost rises 10X. A mismatched hash or late timestamp slashes the bond and freezes repeat offenders, with every quartz checkpoint visible to the zenith.
